definitions.explanation: A feeling of being annoyed or frustrated.

examples.japanese: {苛立|いらだ}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}せない→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧。
{苛立|いらだ}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
{苛立|いらだ}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧。

notes:
{苛立|いらだ}ち is the noun form of ⟦{苛立|いらだ}つ→苛立つ：07912_iradatsu⟧, expressing irritation or frustration.

FORMS:
- ⟦{苛立|いらだ}つ→苛立つ：07912_iradatsu⟧ (verb): to be irritated
- ⟦{苛立|いらだ}たしい→苛立たしい：29044_iradatashii⟧ (adjective): irritating, frustrating
- {苛立|いらだ}ち (noun): irritation

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {苛立|いらだ}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧: to feel irritation
- {苛立|いらだ}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧: to feel frustration
- {苛立|いらだ}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{募|つの}る→募る：10878_tsunoru⟧: frustration builds up
- {苛立|いらだ}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧: to hide one's irritation
- {苛立|いらだ}ち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to suppress irritation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦イライラ→いらいら：01834_iraira⟧: irritation (onomatopoeia, more casual)
- ⟦{焦|あせ}り→焦り：05812_aseri⟧: frustration, impatience
- ⟦もどかしさ→もどかしさ：noentry⟧: frustration (at inability to do something)
